name: slipstream-coach
description: Live customer-aware call coach for Slipstream
author: Slipstream

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Slipstream listens to your microphone to recognise questions you ask during a coached call.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Slipstream listens to call audio to suggest relevant questions and talking points.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Slipstream captures system audio for calls in other apps. Screen video is not recorded.
